cases.sentence: Охозия же упал через решетку своей ___ в Самарии и покалечился.
cases.explain: «верхней комнаты» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Ahaziah fell down through the lattice in his upper room that was in Samaria, and was sick. So he sent messengers, and said to them, “Go, inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron, whether I will recover of this sickness.”

cases.sentence: Тогда царь послал ___ с его людьми.
cases.explain: «третьего пятидесятника» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Again he sent the captain of a third fifty with his fifty. The third captain of fifty went up, and came and fell on his knees before Elijah, and begged him, and said to him, “Man of God, please let my life, and the life of these fifty of your servants, be precious in your sight.

cases.sentence: Ведь огонь, сошедший с небес, пожрал двух ___ и их воинов.
cases.explain: «первых пятидесятников» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Behold, fire came down from the sky, and consumed the last two captains of fifty with their fifties. But now let my life be precious in your sight.”

cases.sentence: Так как у Охозии не было сына, вместо него на втором году правления ___ Иорама, сына Иосафата, воцарился его брат Иорам.
cases.explain: «иудейского царя» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: So he died according to Yahweh’s word which Elijah had spoken. Jehoram began to reign in his place in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, because he had no son.

cases.sentence: Что же до ___ правления Охозии и того, что он сделал, то разве не записаны они в «Книге летописей царей Израиля»?
cases.explain: «прочих событий» — after the preposition «до», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
